verdict.rationale: Casium publishes first-party guides for EB-1A self-petitioning and EB-2 NIW. A blog post covers the foundations of O-1, EB-1, and EB-2 NIW petitions together, and the individuals page promises to lay out "the pathway ahead." That suggests a documented green-card track alongside the O-1, but no evidence explicitly describes moving from O-1 to EB-1A or NIW. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the O-1-to-green-card transition strategy (timing, choosing between EB-1A and NIW, reusing evidence), confirmation that Casium handles the green-card filing as a continuation service, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents the green-card continuation — EB-1A or EB-2 NIW strategy after the work visa — so the O-1 is a path, not a dead end
